pages.title: Om oss - Geiranger Fjordservice AS activities sightseeing tour in Geiranger shorexcursion
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Med majestetisk natur, frodige fossefall, mektige fjell og ein klar, djup fjord har Geiranger sikra seg ein plass på UNESCOs verdsarvliste.
Geiranger Fjordservice AS er eit aksjeselskap med lokale eigarar og kontor i Geiranger. Gjennom tett samarbeid tek vi sikte på å gjere Geiranger til ein enda betre destinasjon. Målet er å gi kvar enkelt gjest ei god oppleving av Geiranger, blant anna ved å samarbeide om kjerneproduktet Geirangerfjord.
Geiranger Fjordservice har utleige av syklar, kajakk, og bilar og kan dessutan tilby transport, guiding og ulike opplevingar og aktivitetar.
Som lokal aktør ønskjer vi å gi nettopp deg ei unik oppleving av staden.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Geiranger Fjordservice AS Google profile: rating 4.6/5, 1484 ratings.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Cruising was a highlight of our trip to Geiranger. It was our first time on a ship of this size, and it was completely battery-powered, leaving no pollution in the fjord. The ship was comfortable and well-equipped. We downloaded a guide app before the cruise, which provided us with valuable information. At some major attractions, the staff offered additional and more personalized directions. The scenery was simply breathtaking and indescribable in words. It felt like only two hours had passed.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: The views are beautiful, but the tour was nothing to write home about. They recommend you download the Guide to Go app, which explains many of the sights as you go past them. For much less money, especially if in a group, you could take the ferry to Hellesylt and see much more of the fjord, while still having everything explained by the Guide to Go app.

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Lovely boat trip with so much to see! 🚢 You can choose a 1 or 2-hour trip, including a stop for the hike. The Seven Sisters waterfall and the fjords look incredible, and the Skageflå hike is well worth it! Note: The water can get choppy and it gets very windy on board. We dealt with a very rude guy at reception, but it didn't ruin our trip. Highly recommend if you’re heading to Geiranger! 🙌

external_observations.label: positive
external_observations.evidence_span: Must see while in Norway. The guide is great and gives a fun and detailed history. Really stunning

external_observations.label: positive
